decisions.decision: Grafana auth via admin basic-auth (password_file on Pi), not API token
decisions.rationale: Grafana pod has no PVC - service-account tokens would vanish on restart. Admin password is config-driven via admin.existingSecret, survives pod restarts. Pi reads password from file at startup, sends as HTTP Basic auth on annotation POST. Offline-first compatible (no 1P fetch at runtime).

decisions.decision: Reuse existing 'grafana' 1P entry in Discworld vault
decisions.rationale: Avoids duplicating secrets across vault items. Means observability Grafana and Shit-of-Theseus Grafana share admin password - acceptable, both are admin-only surfaces.

decisions.decision: Pi case PCB_TOL bumped from 0.6 to 1.0 (0.5mm per side)
decisions.rationale: Every prior physical print has needed a second attempt. More margin reduces the chance of a re-print.

decisions.decision: HDMI_SLOT width 15mm is intentional despite 13.5mm HDMI0/HDMI1 centre spacing
decisions.rationale: Slots merge into a single opening - acceptable because only one HDMI (screen) is used at a time, and the ~29mm bridge across the top prints cleanly in PETG.

decisions.decision: USB-C moved from right short wall to front long wall
decisions.rationale: USB-C is on the HDMI edge of the Pi 5, not the USB/Ethernet edge. Original code had it on the wrong wall entirely.
Needed 1.5mm material under the counterbore for M4 head - FLOOR=2.0 was insufficient with a 1.5mm counterbore on top.
